# A tab's panel is mounted with the tabs and stays mounted while another is
# selected, on every target: a counter in one panel keeps its count across a
# switch away and back, so does a `var` written in a panel, and a panel never
# selected has mounted already, once. `ui.tabs` renders each panel in a box
# whose `display` is `none` unless its tab is selected, where it rendered the
# selected one alone under an `if`, which started every other panel again as it
# came back. testdata/tabs_panels_stay_loaded.txtar is the code.
#
# fyne and gtk4 hide the box (`hidden`); the panel boxes are instances built at
# run time, one per tab, and each one's render cleared the Model's field a test
# null-tests the counter in the first by, so a render of the second's said the
# first's was gone (releaseRemovedInstances). bubbletea draws a hidden Layout as
# nothing, and the snapshot holds the second panel and not the first. html
# keeps every tabpanel in the document with all but one `hidden`. android
# pages through the panels in a HorizontalPager that keeps every page composed.
#
# A swipe is sngl:test/mobile's, answered on android and html. Swiping left
# chooses the next tab that is not disabled, as pressing it would: android's
# pager turns a page and goes on past a disabled one, html's `sngl-swipe`
# hears the pointer and dispatches `swipe`, whose handler skips it.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html shown.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
grep 'role="tabpanel" hidden=""><span style="display: contents;"><span>first panel</span>' shown.sngl.snapshots/second.html
grep 'role="tabpanel"><span style="display: contents;"><span>second panel</span>' shown.sngl.snapshots/second.html

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go shown.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
grep 'second panel' shown.sngl.snapshots/second.ansi
! grep 'first panel' shown.sngl.snapshots/second.ansi

sngl test --platform=html swipe.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin swipe.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

var mounts = 0

component counter ui.node {
    var hits = 0

    ui.button #press(text="{hits}", @click {
        hits += 1
    })
}

component later ui.node {
    effect(@mount {
        mounts += 1
    })
    ui.text(value="later")
}

component panels ui.node {
    var idx = 0
    var seen = 0

    ui.tabs #strip(:selected=idx) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            counter #c
        }
        ui.tab(label="Two") {
            var taps = 0
            ui.button #tap(text="{taps}", @click {
                taps += 1
                seen = taps
            })
        }
        ui.tab(label="Three") {
            later
        }
    }
}

func testAPanelKeepsItsStateAcrossASwitch(t test.Test, c panels) {
    if c.c != null {
        c.c.press.click()
        c.c.press.click()
    }
    c.strip.change(1)
    c.strip.change(0)
    t.assert(c.c != null)
    if c.c != null {
        t.assert(c.c.hits == 2)
    }
}

func testABlockKeepsItsStateAcrossASwitch(t test.Test, c panels) {
    c.strip.change(1)
    if c.tap != null {
        c.tap.click()
    }
    c.strip.change(0)
    c.strip.change(1)
    t.assert(c.tap != null)
    if c.tap != null {
        c.tap.click()
    }
    t.assert(c.seen == 2)
}

func testEveryPanelMountsWithTheTabs(t test.Test, c panels) {
    t.assert(mounts == 1)
    c.strip.change(2)
    c.strip.change(0)
    c.strip.change(2)
    t.assert(mounts == 1)
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    panels
}
-- shown.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component shown ui.node {
    var idx = 0

    ui.tabs #strip(:selected=idx) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            ui.text(value="first panel")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Two") {
            ui.text(value="second panel")
        }
    }
}

func testOnlyTheSelectedPanelShows(t test.Test, c shown) {
    c.strip.change(1)
    t.snapshot("second")
}
-- swipe.sngl --
import mobile "sngl:test/mobile"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component pages ui.node {
    var idx = 0
    var changed = -1

    ui.tabs #strip(:selected=idx, @change(i) {
        changed = i
    }) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            ui.text(value="one")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Two", disabled=true) {
            ui.text(value="two")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Three") {
            ui.text(value="three")
        }
    }
}

func testASwipeLeftChoosesTheNextTab(t test.Test, c pages) {
    mobile.swipe(c.strip, mobile.Toward.left)
    t.assert(c.idx == 2)
    t.assert(c.changed == 2)
    mobile.swipe(c.strip, mobile.Toward.right)
    t.assert(c.idx == 0)
    t.assert(c.changed == 0)
}
